title: Real Estate Due-Diligence Document Review

blueprintSignals.name: Checklist coverage
blueprintSignals.definition: share of required document types present and reviewed
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Definitions of required vary by deal, so use a template per type

blueprintSignals.name: Issue precision
blueprintSignals.definition: share of flagged issues that a lawyer accepts as real
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Reviewers disagree, so measure agreement as well

blueprintSignals.name: Citation validity
blueprintSignals.definition: share of issues whose cited passage supports the statement
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: A passage can be real and still not support the claim, so check entailment

blueprintSignals.name: Material flag
blueprintSignals.definition: severity score assigned by a rule set tied to value and legal risk
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Severity involves judgement, so calibrate with lawyers

label: For "Real Estate Due-Diligence Document Review": Review data-room documents (title, leases, surveys, environmental, contracts) for a property acquisition, flag issues and draft a report with citations. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past deals used for tuning are the easy ones that closed, so recall on hard deals is overstated.
